title: Amma FIzza Abbas ko bulaana
body:
Aagaya bazaar e shaam..(5)
<<MINI>>
Aada ke pattharo ka zainab bani nishana
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
Chadar nahi hai sar par.. haye haye(2)
hai be haya zamana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
Aada ke pattharo ka zainab bani nishana
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Raaho mein chalte chalte kyu qafela ruka hai
jakda hai bediyo'n mein sajjad gir gaya hai
aata hai shimr lekar.. haye haye(2)
haatho mein taziyana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jakdi hui rasan mein lachar bibiya'n hai
sar par rida nahi hai purkhaar wadiya'n hai
in wadiyo'n mein chal kar.. haye haye(2)
pandhra so (1500) meel jaana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Shabbir ki yateema khati hai jab tamache
mai roke puchti hu tujhko bachau kaise
abbas ko bulale.. haye haye(2)
deta hai shimr taana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Baalo se apna chehra har gaam par chupau
mai malka e haya hu darbaar kaise jaau
mai ro rhi hu lekin.. haye haye(2)
hasta hai ye zamana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zainab ka naam lekar zalim bula raha hai
sajjad natawa ko phir khoo rula raha hai
ghairat ke us khuda ko.. haye haye(2)
manzar hai ye dikhana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kaise baya'n karenge farhan aur mazhar
har gaam keh rahi thi zainab yehi to rokar
bazaar se guzar kar.. haye haye(2)
zindaan tak hai jaana
<<MINI>>
amma fizza abbas ko bulana
